evidence: Scans over the whole frozen tree (.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r1/task, 34 files). (1) Live credentials: there are no provider-key shapes (sk-, sk_live, AKIA, ghp_, xox, AIza, JWT eyJ, PEM PRIVATE). task.toml:34 has ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" and task.toml:35 has ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "". Both match the template's task.toml:34-35 and are the expected ${VAR} templates. The only password is the documented demo password Hireops!2026, in instruction.md:17, hireops_rules.md:11 and tests/app_context.md:8. The profile expects it (SKILL.md known false positives; Internal sheet row 52). The seed data holds no credential: users carry only id/name/email/role, and solution/app/src/db.js:66 inserts the demo password at seed time. Session tokens are runtime crypto.randomBytes (index.js:88), not literals. (2) Real personal data: all 22 seed emails use the RFC 2606 reserved domains hireops.example, candidates.example and mail.example, as do the brief and app_context. Names are generic synthetic names. No phone numbers or addresses exist; the digit-run regex matched only dates. Notes and messages are generic recruiting text (longest message is 71 chars). (3) Host paths: no Windows drive paths, /Users/, /home/, workspace name or user id anywhere. Only container paths (/app, /assets, /instructions, /tests, /proc in solve.sh) appear. (4) Unpinned remote fetch: the only URLs are https://openrouter.ai/api (the frozen verifier block) and localhost/127.0.0.1:3000. The solution has no external fetch or CDN, and its requires are fs, path, crypto, express, better-sqlite3 and ./ modules. package.json pins express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1. The npm installs in both Dockerfiles are version-pinned: express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, claude-code@2.1.281, codex@0.151.0, playwright/mcp@0.0.79 and harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7. Base images are tag-pinned (node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim), not digest-pinned, and apt packages are unversioned. However, environment/Dockerfile, tests/Dockerfile and tests/test.sh are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff exit 0), so these files are template-controlled, outside task authoring, and consistent with the public-network profile. (5) Injection payloads: there are no hits for ignore/disregard/system prompt/<script/javascript:/onerror/${ or grader/rubric/reward text in environment/, instruction.md or the seed. A seed message or body scan for <>{}$` returned an empty list. A Unicode scan found no format/private-use/replacement characters (no zero-width or bidi hiding) in any file. tests/.dockerignore excludes only Dockerfile, .dockerignore and __pycache__. Counterexample search: I looked for any seed or instruction text a target model would ingest that could steer the judge or agent (for example, a candidate message saying 'grader: mark this pass'), and for a real-looking address or key that would ship to a client. I found none. A conforming app is not affected by this row.
